summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Espresso Beso coffee service platform. Core functionality mostly working but critical cart persistence issue identified despite localStorage implementation.

ui_bugs.issue: Critical cart persistence failure - items show in badge/toast but cart page displays empty

integration_issues.issue: localStorage cart data not syncing with CartPage component display

passed_tests: Homepage loads correctly with hero section and zone selector
Menu page displays 8 items with category filters (All, Cold, Espresso, Latte)
Add to cart shows success toast and updates cart badge
Admin registration toggle shows name field correctly
Admin login successful with test credentials (admin@espressobeso.com)
Admin dashboard loads with orders section accessible
Mobile responsive design works on 390x844 viewport
Zone selector on homepage displays 3 zones (Spokane Valley, South Hill, North Spokane)

critical_fixes: Fix cart persistence issue - cart state not displaying on CartPage despite localStorage data
Investigate disconnect between cart badge/toast success and CartPage component rendering
investigation_needed: Check CartPage useEffect dependencies for localStorage cart loading
Verify cart state management between add-to-cart and cart page navigation
Test add-to-cart customization modal flow (may have timing issues)
